name: jdownloader-2
description: JDownloader 2 download manager with a browser-based desktop interface

fields.name: WEB_PORT
fields.label: R1: Web Interface Port
fields.help: Host port used to open the JDownloader browser interface. In Host Mode, JDownloader listens directly on NAS port 5800.

fields.name: WEB_AUTHENTICATION_USERNAME
fields.label: R2: Web Username
fields.help: Username required to open the protected browser interface. This protects the container's web desktop and is separate from a MyJDownloader account.

fields.name: WEB_AUTHENTICATION_PASSWORD
fields.label: R3: Web Password
fields.help: Generated password for the protected browser interface. Save it securely before deployment.

fields.name: CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: R4: Config Folder
fields.help: Host folder for JDownloader settings, application state, and container configuration.

fields.name: OUTPUT_LOCATION
fields.label: R5: Downloads Folder
fields.help: Host folder where completed and in-progress downloads are stored. Inside JDownloader, select a destination under /output.

fields.name: USER_ID
fields.label: R6: User ID
fields.help: Numeric ID of the NAS user that should own downloaded files. Check the owner of your selected folders; do not assume every NAS uses 1000.

fields.name: GROUP_ID
fields.label: R7: Group ID
fields.help: Numeric ID of the NAS group that should own downloaded files. The example value 10 is not suitable for every NAS, so this recipe uses the image default of 1000.

fields.name: TZ
fields.label: R8: Timezone
fields.help: Container timezone, such as Asia/Dubai or Etc/UTC.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_NETWORK_MODE
fields.label: O1: Network
fields.help: Choose Create New Bridge for the recommended default, Host Mode, or an existing named Docker network. Host Mode normally offers no advantage for JDownloader's web interface.

fields.name: DARK_MODE
fields.label: O2: Dark Mode
fields.help: Controls the dark visual theme for the container's browser interface.

fields.name: WEB_AUTHENTICATION
fields.label: O3: Web Authentication
fields.help: Protects the browser interface with the username and password above. The image requires Secure Connection to be enabled when web authentication is enabled.

fields.name: SECURE_CONNECTION
fields.label: O4: Secure Connection
fields.help: Enables HTTPS for the browser interface. Keep this enabled while Web Authentication is enabled. The included certificate may be self-signed, so your browser can display a warning on first access.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: O5: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_IMAGE
fields.label: A1: Image
fields.help: JDownloader 2 container image maintained by Jocelyn Le Sage. Change this only if you need a pinned tag or another image source.

fields.name: WEB_SCHEME
fields.label: A2: Web Link Protocol
fields.help: Protocol EasyDocker uses for the Open JDownloader link. Keep HTTPS when Secure Connection is enabled; change this to HTTP only if Secure Connection is disabled.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_PORT_MAPPING
fields.label: A3: Bridge Port Mapping
fields.help: Automatically generated for bridge or an existing Docker network and removed in Host Mode.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_INTERNAL_PORT
fields.label: Internal Web Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed browser interface port inside the container.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_CONFIG_TARGET
fields.label: Config Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal configuration path.

fields.name: JDOWNLOADER_OUTPUT_TARGET
fields.label: Downloads Path Inside Container
fields.help: Recipe-managed internal downloads path.

ui.overview: JDownloader 2 manages downloads through a full desktop interface available securely from a web browser.
what_happens: One JDownloader 2 container will be created
Application configuration and downloads will be stored in bind-mounted host folders
The browser interface will be protected with the selected username and generated password
HTTPS is enabled by default because the image requires it for web authentication
A browser warning can appear because the container's default HTTPS certificate may be self-signed
The selected NAS user and group IDs will control ownership of files created in the downloads folder
Bridge networking is selected by default, with Host Mode and existing Docker networks also available
Inside JDownloader, download destinations should be selected under /output
ui.data_location: The config and downloads folders can be relative to this app's config folder or absolute host paths. Make sure the selected user and group IDs can write to both folders.
